Equipment.en: Stopwatch, Measuring Tape, Heart Rate Monitor, Dynamometer

Description.en: A comprehensive fitness assessment including cardiorespiratory, strength, and flexibility measures

Instructions.de: Führen Sie alle Tests der Reihe nach durch. Pausieren Sie 2 Minuten zwischen den Tests. Sorgen Sie für ein ordentliches Aufwärmen vor Beginn.
Instructions.en: Complete all tests in order. Rest 2 minutes between tests. Ensure proper warm-up before starting.

ExclusionCriteria.en: Acute illness, cardiovascular conditions, recent injuries

Description.en: Resting heart rate measured after 5 minutes of seated rest
Maximum duration holding a standard plank position
Heart rate immediately after 3-minute step test
Maximum grip strength with left hand using dynamometer
Maximum grip strength with right hand using dynamometer
Estimated maximum oxygen uptake based on step test performance

Metadata.Purpose: Fitness assessment template for PRISM biometrics conversions
